results.note: NBS release of 31 Oct 2026 '2026年10月中国采购经理指数运行情况': the manufacturing PMI was 49.3%, down 0.8 points from September.
The NBS release of 31 Oct 2026 puts October's manufacturing PMI at 49.3%, below 50.0.

Poland Insight (30 Oct, updated 31 Oct) states that 'no candidate or selection deadline has been announced'; Imen Economics (30 Oct) quotes Pierrakakis only as saying the Eurogroup 'will act swiftly', and the Spanish and Dutch backing for Hernández de Cos and Knot dates from before the window (Dutch backing reported 6 Aug, per Central Banking and Accountantweek).
